item.title: US army calls detonation of bomb chemicals in Iowa a success after fears of toxic plume
item.description:
A sign identifying the facility sits inside a fence surrounding the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa, on November 19, 2026. | Scott Olson/Getty Images This story appeared in Today, Explained, a daily newsletter that helps you understand the most compelling news and stories of the day. Subscribe here . On Wednesday, the Pentagon blew up about five tons of lead azide, an unstable explosive stored at an ammunition plant in Iowa, in order to dispose of it, sending a toxic plume of lead dust into the sky the day before Thanksgiving. The detonation was briefly halted by a lower court before a federal circuit court cleared the way on Monday, and went forward despite serious public health concerns. There was a real need for haste, according to the Army : The lead azide was sufficiently unstable that it was at risk of detonating on its own in an uncontrolled explosion, and falling…

item.title: In California, exceptional tides and nearly 9m-high waves batter the coast
item.description:
California spent two months preparing for El Niño. This week, as king tides and a powerful Thanksgiving winter storm batter the coast, the state will find out if it is ready. In September, Gov. Gavin Newsom proclaimed a state of emergency for El Niño. In the proclamation and subsequent executive orders , he directed agencies to speed up permits, move supplies and people and suspend some of the state’s own rules. The state Office of Emergency Services and Department of Water Resources asked operators of levees and dams to inspect facilities ahead of the storm. The state agencies prepared sandbags, portable flood barriers and materials for emergency repairs. The state is also deploying swiftwater rescue vehicles, boats and other specialized equipment. For most Californians, city and county agencies will be the first line of defense, with the state offering back-up if needed. “We continue…

item.title: Diesel tanker capsizes near Ibiza, killing crew member
item.description:
Authorities rescued 17 crew members but one later died in hospital after a diesel tanker sank off the Spanish island of Ibiza. A contingency plan against possible pollution damage is now in place.

item.description:

On the East Coast, authorities in Philadelphia ordered the city’s Thanksgiving Day parade in Philadelphia off the streets and will be featured as an “alternative TV event”. Continue reading...

item.title: EU leaders struggle to agree on long-term budget, more money for Ukraine
item.description:
